questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Recognize the explicitly fraudulent telephone help-desk reset request as voice deception with a fabricated CFO identity/story; the combined answer is one decision.
questionProposals.contentQualification: HOLD combined vishing/pretexting answer as two separately graded skills or independent families. Claiming to be an executive does not make the recipient an executive or automatically whaling; targeting can overlap voice phishing.

questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Recognize the supplied indiscriminate fraudulent bank email as generic/bulk phishing rather than explicitly targeted or voice delivery.
questionProposals.contentQualification: HOLD phishing as only mass email: it is an umbrella that includes targeted variants and other channels. Main answer is supported by explicit random-recipient premises. Wrong spear-phishing feedback restricts it to a specific named individual with personalised details; that is too narrow for targeted groups/company/industry. Preserve this feedback qualification hold and withhold precise spear-phishing contrast linkage; no correction or secondary assessment is activated.

questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Recognize the explicitly identical bank-impersonation emails to unrelated recipients as generic phishing; distinguish targeting and voice/SMS channel distractors.
questionProposals.contentQualification: HOLD generic label as proof all phishing is untargeted or all targeted messages need named individuals. The effective stem now expressly supplies identical messages to unrelated recipients; the authored single-bank-email stem did not establish bulk targeting. Channel and targeting are distinct dimensions, not disjoint universal actor identities.

questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Recognize the fraudulent bank SMS lure as smishing; the fake link is context, not a domain-attack classification decision.

Authored feedback wrongly compounded homograph/typosquatting; effective feedback removes it. questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Recognize the fake executive help-desk call as voice-based persuasion using authority/urgency to bypass verification; no verification procedure is executed.
questionProposals.contentQualification: HOLD authority/urgency as proof of scarcity, sponsor or unique attacker; travel context supplies no scarce resource. The answer recognizes social persuasion, not credential-pair reuse, website compromise or session replay. Effective feedback suggests trusted-contact verification/escalation but no callback/control is executed; self-identification or attacker-provided contact details cannot verify identity.
